positioning_statement: KORR measures actual oxygen consumption breath-by-breath (direct measurement), where consumer wearables estimate VO2 max from heart-rate/pace models. The source material frames this as a factual distinction, not a competitive attack.

comparison_points.gap: Estimate VO2 max from HR/pace models rather than measuring it directly
comparison_points.korr_distinction: Breath-by-breath gas exchange analysis measures actual oxygen consumption — considered the gold standard for accuracy

rules: No named commercial competitors were provided in the source material — do not invent any
Frame the wearable-vs-lab distinction factually (measurement vs. estimation), never as a takedown of any specific wearable brand
Never use praise language ("best", "amazing", "perfect") when discussing KORR in user-generated/Reddit-style content
